[SWS_DM_01211] Transition to DeAuthenticated state on S3server timeout
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04240
⌈
On an S3 Server timeout, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall reset the Au-
thentication State to
kDeAuthenticated
for the client which timed out.
⌋
